verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a public REST API covering wallets, rules, transfers and pay-in simulation, with concrete endpoints, Hawk-based API key authentication, an API explorer, a sandbox, and an llms.txt index that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. The core capability is clearly delivered through first-party documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end, explicit evidence of a published machine-readable spec (e.g. OpenAPI).
